_comment: Part numbers for the five through-hole placements the vendor Fabrication
Toolkit plugins cannot source. Those plugins read an LCSC/MPN field off the
footprint; these parts carry none, so every regeneration emits them blank and
any curation added by hand is silently lost the next time the plugin runs.
That has already happened once - jlc_verify.py's THT_MPN filled the etherCON
manufacturer in, and the 2026-08-04 plugin run wiped it back out.
Keyed by designator, not by Value substring, so a value string edit cannot
quietly stop a part matching. Read by scripts/consolidate_vendor_bom.py,
which reapplies them after each regeneration.
These are placements, not a decision about who fits them. Whether a given
line is populated on a given order is passed to that script with --dnp.

J201.note: etherCON CAT5 B-series PCB receptacle, CAN A. No LCSC listing. PCBWay quoted USD 10.285 ea, 7-10 workday lead, on the rev A PCBWay order.

J202.note: etherCON CAT5 B-series PCB receptacle, CAN B.

J401.note: etherCON CAT5 B-series PCB receptacle, LAN.

J301.note: 1x6 1.27mm vertical pin header, UART/debug. Datasheet-recommended PCB hole 0.65mm matches PinHeader_1x06_P1.27mm_Vertical exactly; pins 0.4x0.4mm square. 12,218 in stock 2026-08-10. Alternate DZ127R-11-06-25 (C2935946).

SW201.note: 2-position SPST slide DIP, CAN termination. 2.54mm pitch, 7.62mm row, body 9.9x6.5mm inside the 9.78x7.26mm courtyard. Pins 0.56x0.15mm clear our 0.8mm drill although the datasheet asks for 1.0mm - do not enlarge. 31,049 in stock 2026-08-10. Alternate DS-02RP (C92646) has 0.6mm terminals and is a tighter fit.
